The client answered:
1. CCB: bank manager's informal promise only, nothing signed; they only sign near maturity → confirms: classification circulating stands. Aditivo not signed until balance date → evento subsequente não ajustável if signed later. Confidence: my conclusion stands. Update documents: Nota (premissa 3 confirmed), carta, status.
2. AFAC: sócios never formalized; AGE possible in January if it helps → January 2026 is after balance date. Question: does an AGE in January fix the classification at 31/12/2025? The capitalization must happen by the deadline at/at the balance date basis. The RFB practice requires capitalization until the first AGE/contractual amendment after receipt or within 120 days of the year end — an AGE in January 2026 would be far beyond those deadlines (received mar/2022; first AGE after receipt would have been ~April/May 2022). So classification at 31/12/2025 = passivo (mútuo) stands. A January AGE could be a subsequent event or a new arrangement going forward — cannot re-retroactively make it patrimonio líquido at 31/12/2025. Request: confirm whether reconstruindo from scratch... Also worth noting: converting AFAC now could be possible via a new formalization (capitalization in jan/2026) as a forward event — that doesn't change the 31/12/2025 classification. And fiscally, the mútuo probably already triggers IOF/juros presumidos; a capitalization in jan/2026 might regularize going forward. Present nuance carefully: only library statements; note that a post-balance-date AGE is a subsequent event (não ajustável) — classification at 31/12/2025 remains passivo. If the sócios actually want to capitalize in January, that's a business decision that may have prospective effects and possibly fiscal regularization; flag for the tax advisor.
3. Waiver: debenturistas not yet contacted; February if needed → confirms no waiver by balance date → all circulating. February waiver would be post-balance non-adjustable event; disclosure. Warn urgency: the escritura says breach → automatic early maturity; delay until February increases risk; recommend starting immediately.

Unknowns remaining:
- What the composition of the labor process remains; nature fiscal of the despesa — client has no additional info.
- Quadro of the remaining R$ 24.7M loans — no info.
- AFAC: no instrument; exact data in mar/2022; any AGE/contractual alteration after receipt? The client says "sócios nunca formalizaram o aumento" — and "podemos fazer a AGE agora em janeiro". It implies no AGE happened. So the AFAC-passivo conclusion is final at 31/12/2025. Remaining unknown: fiscal quantification (IOF/juros presumidos) — no info; flag.
- EBITDA audited confirmation — balancete pré-fechamento is the only base; flag.
- Interpretation of escritura re: mútuo ex-AFAC in DL — client has no additional info (it's a contract interpretation question; flag remains; sensitivity disclosed).

Now update the deliverables:
- nota_explicativa.md: update premissas (2,3 now confirmed facts), add "cliente confirmou" notes where relevant; adjust item abertos list (remove some, keep others). Specifically:
  - Premissa 2 (no waiver) → now stated fact: client confirmed no contact with debenture holders; advise urgent initiation. February = subsequent event; reclassificação do total para circulante.
  - Premissa 3 (no aditivo) → confirmed fact: nothing signed; bank signs only near maturity → renewal informal promise without contract substance → classification circulante firm; disclosure of subsequent renegotiation plans.
  - AFAC section: add the note about AGE in January (post-balance events); classification stands passivo. Mention it could be regularização prospectively; fiscal advisor.
  - Abertos: remove waiver premissa (now fact) but keep "tratativas ainda não iniciadas; urgency".
- carta_diretoria.md: maybe update items 2/3 with client confirmations + note urgency on waiver in February (recommend earlier). Should I edit carta? The carta was our answer already written; client's replies confirm our positions. It's fine to add a brief addendum section "Atualização pós-resposta do cliente" with the three confirmations. Better to place addendum in the carta.
- PERGUNTAS.md: mark answered items (1,2,3,5 partially) and keep remaining open (4,6,7), noting Client has no additional information.
- STATUS.md: remains COMPLETE WITH OPEN ITEMS; update open items list; note client's confirmations incorporated.

Also JSON: ccb classificaçcirculante stands; provisão manter stands; afac passivo stands; covenant numbers unchanged (client's AGE in january does not change the 31/12 classification — and the CEO might hope AGE January could fix; explain: não ajustável/toda via subsequent; also the deadline already lapsed in 2022 (120 dias / first AGE); so no).

Actually careful nuance: could the AGE in january make the AFAC... no. At 31/12/2025 there is no obligation with defined capitalization; even if the AGE happens in January, the classification as of the balance date follows the conditions at that date; the PN deadline had long passed; and can't potion. Also: would reclassifying the AFAC to capital in January imply re-typification retroactively? Not our call; flag to tax advisor; library doesn't cover the "regularization forward" question. State as unverified/open.

Also the covenant: does the client's AGE idea affect the covenant? No. DL unchanged; indexe unchanged. And waiver in February doesn't change the classification at the balance date (non-adjustable subordinate event; classification circulante at 31/12) — per cpc24 file: waiver obtained after balance date is a non-adjusting subsequent event. Disclose.

One subtlety per the cpc24 library quote: "Quebra de covenant na data do balanço que torne a dívida exigível → classificação circulante, salvo se o credor concedeu waiver até a data do balanço; waiver obtido após a data do balanço é evento não ajustável." Good.

Also, should I ask anything else? The user says "For questions not answered above, the client has no additional information. Flag remaining unknowns explicitly. Continue the engagement." → no new questions; keep remaining as flagged unknowns in PERGUNTAS.md/STATUS.ts.
